title: kbgit.py ext-release tags the main branch as ext-vX.Y.Z from API_VERSION and its changelog entry, and sync carries the tag to the integration remote
goal: kbgit.py ext-release [--root REPO] [--dry-run] refuses with exit 2 naming what is missing a version with no kb/_self/extension-changelog.md entry, an existing tag, a checkout off the main branch or one with uncommitted tracked changes; it makes the annotated tag ext-v<API_VERSION> with the changelog entry as its message; --dry-run prints the tag and the message and makes no tag; kg_sync.tags_to_push(root, base, head) lists the ext-v tags that point at commits of the range, which kbgit.py sync --push sends with them

run:
import json,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kg_sync
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
def git(d,*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(d),*a],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
bare=T/"bare.git"; subprocess.run(["git","init","-q","--bare","-b","main",str(bare)],check=True)
d=T/"w"; d.mkdir(); git(d,"init","-q","-b","main"); git(d,"config","user.name","t"); git(d,"config","user.email","t@corp.example.com"); git(d,"remote","add","origin",str(bare))
(d/"a").write_text("1\n"); git(d,"add","-A"); git(d,"commit","-qm","a"); git(d,"push","-q","origin","main")
git(d,"tag","-a","ext-v0.1.0","-m","x"); git(d,"tag","plain"); git(d,"tag","-a","ext-v0.2.0","-m","x"); git(d,"push","-q","origin","ext-v0.2.0")
(d/"a").write_text("2\n"); git(d,"commit","-qam","b"); git(d,"tag","-a","ext-v0.3.0","-m","x")
got=kg_sync.missing_ext_tags(str(d),"origin")
sys.exit(0 if got==["ext-v0.1.0"] else "not yet: "+json.dumps(got))

clauses.clause: kbgit.py ext-release [--root REPO] [--dry-run] refuses with exit 2 naming what is missing a version with no kb/_self/extension-changelog.md entry, an existing tag, a checkout off the main branch or one with uncommitted tracked changes
it makes the annotated tag ext-v<API_VERSION> with the changelog entry as its message
--dry-run prints the tag and the message and makes no tag
kg_sync.tags_to_push(root, base, head) lists the ext-v tags that point at commits of the range, which kbgit.py sync --push sends with them

gates.question: Which version does the first ext tag carry?
gates.reason: groups inside and outside the organization adopt from day one and only a major may break them; a 0.x series would promise nothing until 1.0

gates.question: Which version does ext-release tag when --root names another repository, and what is the tag message?
options: kbext.API_VERSION of the running tools, message 'Extension API V' then the changelog entry body
API_VERSION read from the root's own _tools/kbext.py
gates.recommendation: kbext.API_VERSION of the running tools, message 'Extension API V' then the changelog entry body
gates.reason: the tools that tag are the ones that lint, and a repository without _tools/kbext.py can still be tagged
gates.answer: kbext.API_VERSION of the running tools, message 'Extension API V' then the changelog entry body

gates.question: Which sync pushes carry the ext-v tags?
options: only a push of the range to the integration main, not a code branch push
gates.recommendation: only a push of the range to the integration main, not a code branch push
gates.reason: the main branch does not move on a code branch push, so a tag of main would point at a commit main lacks
gates.answer: only a push of the range to the integration main, not a code branch push
